tagline: Job-type checklists while you learn the ropes
notes: Starter drafts for a new BevChain/Linfox HR driver in Brisbane. User is still learning — especially Kegs. Everything should be easy to edit later. Mark Kegs as 'still learning'. Australian English.

jobTypes.name: Electronic Pallet Jack
jobTypes.summary: Powered pallet jack for palletised drops.

sections.title: Before you leave the yard
items: Check roster / run sheet and note EPJ sites
PPE on (hi-vis, safety boots, gloves as required)
Inspect EPJ: battery charge, forks, wheels, controls, emergency stop
Confirm EPJ loads correctly onto truck / is secured for travel
Walk truck: load secure, straps/gates, lights, tyres, mirrors
Paperwork / handheld / scanner charged and working

sections.title: At the customer site
items: Park safely, hazard lights / cones if needed, check access path
Find receiving contact / bay and confirm drop location
Unload EPJ safely, check path for people, gutters, slopes, wet floors
Move pallets one controlled move at a time — no rushing corners
Place pallets where directed; don't block fire exits or traffic
Get POD / signature / scan confirmation before leaving
Reload EPJ onto truck and re-secure for road

sections.title: After the drop
items: Update run sheet / handheld status
Note any site access issues for next time
Check remaining charge / damage on EPJ
Move to next stop or return to yard

jobTypes.name: Hand Unload
jobTypes.summary: Manual case / carton unload where EPJ or pallet drop isn't used.

sections.title: Before you leave the yard
items: Check run sheet for hand-unload sites and case counts
PPE on; grab gloves if cases are rough or cold
Confirm load plan — heavy / crushables / cold chain where relevant
Walk truck: load secure, doors/gates, lights, tyres, mirrors
Handheld / scanner charged

sections.title: At the customer site
items: Park safely and check the path from truck to stock room / coolroom
Find receiving contact; confirm where product goes
Open doors carefully; mind falling cartons
Lift with legs, keep loads close, don't twist under weight
Stack to site standard — stable, labelled face out where required
Keep walkways clear as you work
Count / scan against invoice or pick list
Get POD / signature before leaving
Close and secure truck for road

sections.title: After the drop
items: Update run sheet / handheld
Note awkward sites, stairs, long carries, or missing gear
Hydrate / reset before next stop
Move to next stop or return to yard

jobTypes.name: Kegs
jobTypes.badge: Still learning — fill this in as you train
jobTypes.summary: Keg drops and returns. Starter shell only until you've done the training.

sections.title: Before you leave the yard
items: Confirm which sites are keg drops / keg returns
Check keg count, full vs empty, and any deposit tags
Confirm correct couplings / fittings if required for the run
Secure kegs for travel (no rolling freights)
PPE and gloves ready

sections.title: At the customer site (draft — refine after training)
items: Park and check path for slopes, steps, and wet floors
Find cellar / coolroom contact and drop point
Move kegs with controlled rolls — never drop or bounce
Place fulls where directed; collect empties / returns as listed
Watch fingers and toes around couplings and rims
Confirm counts (full out / empty back) before leaving
Get POD / signature
Re-secure remaining kegs on truck

sections.title: After the drop
items: Update run sheet with kegs delivered and returned
Note site quirks (stairs, lift, long roll, tight cellar)
Add anything your trainer teaches that isn't on this list yet

sharedEveryJob.title: Every job — do these regardless of type
items: Fatigue check — fit to drive and work
Phone / radio / emergency contacts known
Customer site rules followed (induction, sign-in, speed, PPE)
Incident / near-miss reported the same day
Truck left roadworthy between stops

dayBaseline.title: Every work day (shared)
dayBaseline.sitesNote: Main stops so far: alcohol, mainly Liquorland.

sections.title: Pre-departure
items: Truck already loaded (~12–13 pallets for 2–3 stops)
Weighbridge before leaving depot
Weigh tickets: ~6.5t front axles, ~16.5t rear (~23t total)
Start ~5am; first drop often ~7am

sections.title: On site / delivery
items: Stick to allocated windows (usually ~3 hours)
Tablet: verify and confirm required business/delivery info
Pallets match load → no pallet docket
Under/over pallets → pallet docket, get it signed for what was actually received

sections.title: Driving hours
items: Log book for hours and breaks
